# Skill: database migration

1. Expand only in this release: add tables/columns/indexes; never drop or rename in the same release.
2. Every tenant-owned table has `workspace_id` + index; money columns are `bigint` minor units +
   currency; rates are `numeric`, never float.
3. Generate the migration with the Drizzle toolchain in `packages/db`; review the SQL by hand.
4. Backfill as a separate, idempotent job if needed.
5. Write rollback notes in the PR (what to do if deploy fails mid-way).
6. Tests: migration applies on a clean DB (Testcontainers) and on the seeded demo DB.
7. Contract (drop old) only in a later release after code no longer reads the old shape.
